_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county.label: County
county.expects: a Maine county name WITHOUT the word 'County' (the form prints 'COUNTY'); rendered upper-case
avoid: the trailing word 'County'

docket_no.label: Docket No
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

individual_name.label: Individual Name
individual_name.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: initials or nicknames
a title with no name
'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

petition_type.label: Petition Type
petition_type.expects: check only if the statement is true

petitioner_contact.label: Petitioner Contact
petitioner_contact.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

petitioner_interest.label: Petitioner Interest
petitioner_interest.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

petitioner_interest_other.label: Petitioner Interest Other
petitioner_interest_other.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

individual_address.label: Individual Address
individual_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: a missing ZIP code
the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required

individual_location.label: Individual Location
individual_location.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

individual_return_to_maine.label: Individual Return To Maine
individual_return_to_maine.expects: check only if the statement is true

individual_return_date.label: Individual Return Date
avoid: vague text like 'last spring' or 'unknown'
an impossible/!calendar date
a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields
